info.title: Order Management API
info.description: Order Management System REST API (/api/v1). Authentication endpoints (sign-in/sign-out/get-session) are served by Better Auth outside this contract; use GET /api/v1/auth/me for the merged principal.

id.description: Existing order line id; omit to add a new line.

orderUrlTemplate.description: Carrier order/print site opened from the ordering queue.

carrierId.description: Chosen carrier: auto match, ambiguity resolution, or manual selection.

dispatchedAt.description: Actual dispatch time; defaults to entry time.

reason.description: Required human reason for the correction (§12.12).

trackingNumber.description: Replacement tracking number; defaults to the current one.

carrierId.description: Replacement carrier; defaults to the current one.

fixedTime.description: Daily fixed send time (HH:mm). Wins over the window when set.

workdaysOnly.description: Restrict to Mon-Fri (holiday calendars out of first release).

externalTimezone.description: The one system-wide External Timezone (IANA name).

ownSiteTrackingUrlTemplate.description: Global-default own-site tracking URL template ({number} placeholder). Null clears it.

weightValue.description: Weight value in the chosen unit (required, > 0).

itemVariantId.description: Item variant id (preferred; drives future stock).

title.description: Display title (auto-filled from the variant by the UI).

returnStage.description: Stage to return the order to when resolution is restart.

source.description: Where the problem was reported from.

content.description: What the problem is; shown to the reviewer.

importStartDate.description: Earliest order date to import (ISO 8601). Defaults to all available.

key.description: Optional machine key; auto-generated when omitted.
